semantics: Old vs new on the SAME built content pack, per dimension. MIGRATION_EQUIVALENT only when every dimension is EQUIVALENT; otherwise the old runtime stays the canonical one. Even an equivalent slice is only ELIGIBLE: a migration is a human decision, never taken here.

slices.scenario: BaCl2+H2SO4, NaCl+NaNO3 (not modeled), AgNO3+NaCl, then the net ionic equation — the same choices in both runtimes; the new runtime needs a RESET before the third pair (two tubes, no WASH in the instruction)

instruction.detail: new: the instruction steps, their operations and the grounded step (2) are part of the profile, and only instruction actions are offered (no WASH); old: the reagent shelf only, any number of pairs per attempt

chemistryResult.detail: the same evaluateIonicMixing outcomes, reaction ids and coverage codes for every pair
chemistryResult.evidence: runs both: old ReferencePracticeSession vs new applyLabAction on the built pack

observations.detail: the observation data is the reaction record’s own observation in both

safety.detail: neither runtime has safety text for 8.1 (legacyContent.safety is empty)

completion.detail: same goal (target observed + correct net ionic equation): old complete=true in one attempt; new complete=true in the attempt after RESET

evidence.detail: new: evidence CANDIDATES only (persisted:false); the old runtime writes observation/answer/construction evidence through the orchestrator

accessibility.detail: the new route has its own e2e accessibility checks (tests/e2e/guided-dynamic-lab.spec.mjs); it is not part of the P2.7 sweep (140/5/0/1 unchanged)
